mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END) as inProgressChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as compliantChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'NON_COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as nonCompliantChecks, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2) as complianceRate, AVG(compliance_score) as avgComplianceScore, SUM(violation_count) as totalViolations, COUNT(CASE WHEN action_deadline < CURDATE() AND action_status != 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as overdueActions FROM gt_investment_compliance_check WHERE org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT 'INCREASE_CHECK_FREQUENCY' as recommendationType, CONCAT('建议增加检查频率，当前合规率：', ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2), '%') as recommendationReason, COUNT(*) as totalChecks FROM gt_investment_compliance_check WHERE org_id = #{orgId} HAVING ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) < 80
UNION ALL
SELECT 'IMPROVE_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS' as recommendationType, CONCAT('建议改进纠正措施流程，当前有', COUNT(*), '项逾期未完成') as recommendationReason, COUNT(*) as overdueCount FROM gt_investment_compliance_check WHERE action_deadline < CURDATE() AND action_status != 'COMPLETED' AND org_id = #{orgId} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m') as reportPeriod, COUNT(*) as totalChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as compliantChecks, COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'NON_COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as nonCompliantChecks, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as complianceRate, AVG(compliance_score) as avgComplianceScore, SUM(violation_count) as totalViolations, COUNT(CASE WHEN corrective_action IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as correctiveActionCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN action_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedActionCount FROM gt_investment_compliance_check WHERE check_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY reportPeriod

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m') as period, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN check_result = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as complianceRate, AVG(compliance_score) as avgScore, SUM(violation_count) as violations FROM gt_investment_compliance_check WHERE check_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) AND org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period
